title: Courageous Sailing at Jamaica Pond Boathouse
specs: New fleet of kayaks and standup paddleboards at Jamaica Pond
Sailing on Rhodes 19 keelboats that do not capsize
Sailboat rentals require passing an on-the-water sailing checkout
No swimming requirement stated for youth programs
Corporate outings with customized sailing events and regattas available
Corporate Challenge regatta for companies with 2-4 to 6-12 team members per boat
includes: Qualified instructor for lessons and private sails
gap: Age minimum not stated for rentals or lessons
blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, paddleboards, rowboats, and sailboats or take sailing lessons. Youth programs develop leadership and confidence through sailing. Corporate and private sailing events are also offered.
extraNote: Arrive 10 minutes early and check in at Front Desk · Cancellations with 48+ hours notice for 2-hour sails and private lessons have no penalty · Cancellations within 48 hours incur $60 fee, no refunds unless weather-related · Courses must be scheduled within calendar year; no refunds; reschedule up to 2 weeks before start · Weather cancellations reschedule free of charge for 2-hour sails and lessons · Sailing in light rain or overcast; cancel only for thunderstorms, heavy rain, or unsafe winds · Jamaica Pond Boathouse, 507 Jamaica Way, Jamaica Plain, MA 02130 · Paddling season May 1 through October 31
